scope: Primary-source pipeline, rendering, interchange and character-tool references for Daftar game-development research.

verificationPolicy.sourcePriority: Creator, project maintainer and official product documentation.
verificationPolicy.missingEvidence: An unverified exact title or access condition remains explicitly unverified; it is not inferred from a thumbnail, repost or public repository name.

resources.name: Robin Squares rendering workflow and compositing sheet
verifiedFacts: The creator's sheet page links this workflow video.
The sheet page describes recombining passes and lists a zero-or-more price.
resources.license: No redistribution license established for the video or sheet; retain links and attribution.
resources.access: Public creator page and linked video; creator checkout may be needed for the sheet. No download acquired.
claimCorrections: HOW BIG BOYS RENDER is retained as an unverified submitted alias, not asserted as the video's exact title.
No project GitHub repository was established.

sources.evidence: Page read; creator-linked video URL observed.

resources.name: Robin Squares render-log CSV utility
verifiedFacts: The page describes a Python script for converting a Blender log to CSV and a Tkinter file-selection interface.
resources.license: No reusable code license established; inspect the delivered script and terms before incorporating it.
resources.access: Listed at zero-or-more price; download not acquired.
claimCorrections: This is not evidence of a headless Daftar integration.

sources.evidence: Creator profile link and product description read.

resources.name: stache: Celsius laptop production breakdown
verifiedFacts: The creator's video description includes chapters on memory limitations and optimization.
A film post is marked free; the inspected Celsius source-files breakdown is locked.
resources.license: No general asset redistribution grant established. Creator video, film and project-file terms are distinct.
resources.access: Public video; mixed free and locked Patreon posts. No purchase, subscription or download performed.
claimCorrections: A free film does not establish that every project source file is free.
The production story is not a comparative hardware benchmark.

sources.evidence: Indexed creator title and description inspected.
Public post read.
Title and locked-access state read; gated content not accessed.

resources.name: InLightVFX behind-glass compositing
verifiedFacts: The creator's tutorial concerns a CG object behind glass in live-action footage.
Its description refers to an infographic and project file; the creator site separately offers a commercial VFX course.
resources.license: No open redistribution license established for the footage, project, course or tutorial.
resources.access: Public tutorial and course landing page; unrestricted project-file access was not established. No course acquired.
claimCorrections: The submitted REAL-to-CGI wording is not verified as an exact tutorial title.
Public viewing is not proof that project files are free or open source.

sources.evidence: Indexed creator title and description inspected.
Course and download descriptions read.

resources.name: MB-Lab legacy character generator
verifiedFacts: The community continuation of ManuelBastioniLAB is archived as of July 21, 2024.
The README identifies final version 1.8.1, a Blender 4.0 target, and a move toward CharMorph.
resources.license: Repository contains AGPL-3.0 text and legacy per-file notices. Inspect exact code and model-data terms for the selected revision; no blanket output-asset license inferred.
resources.access: Public archived repository; not installed by this research.
claimCorrections: ManuelBastioniLAB and MB-Lab are related but not interchangeable current project identities.
Archived Blender 4.0+ wording is not current-release compatibility evidence.

sources.evidence: README, archive banner and license-file listing inspected.

resources.name: CharMorph character-tool candidate
verifiedFacts: MB-Lab names CharMorph as its development continuation.
CharMorph's license file states GPL version 3 or later for Python code and separately discusses data.
resources.license: GPL-3.0-or-later for Python code according to license.txt; inspect data and asset terms separately.
resources.access: Public repository; no installation or engine import executed.
claimCorrections: Do not equate a public successor repository with validated support for this project's pinned Blender version.

sources.evidence: Successor named in README.
Project page inspected.
Code-license terms read.

resources.name: Blender add-ons historical mirror
verifiedFacts: The official read-only mirror was archived on May 9, 2025.
The visible tree includes historical FBX and glTF add-on directories.
resources.license: Check each component's license; the repository name is not a uniform asset-use grant.
resources.access: Public source mirror; no bulk installation performed.
claimCorrections: This mirror is not the current universal installer for Blender exporters.
Prefer exporter code matching the actual Blender release.

sources.evidence: Archive banner, mirror link and file tree read.

resources.name: Blender glTF exporter documentation and source
verifiedFacts: Khronos maintains the Blender glTF importer/exporter project.
The Blender 5.2 LTS manual documents default activation and supported material, geometry and animation representations.
resources.license: Apache-2.0 as identified by the exporter repository. Exported third-party assets retain their own rights.
resources.access: Public source and manual; no exporter replacement installed.
claimCorrections: A Blender export option does not prove that a target engine has its corresponding importer installed.
glTF does not preserve arbitrary Blender node graphs or all animation/property behavior.

sources.evidence: Project README and license identification read.
Official indexed page content retrieved; direct page open returned a tool retrieval error.

resources.name: Blender import/export format overview
verifiedFacts: The manual distinguishes formats enabled by default from other bundled add-ons and lists FBX among available formats.
resources.license: Documentation reference; no source or asset redistribution implied.
claimCorrections: Default activation, bundling, extension installation and engine import are separate states.

sources.evidence: Official indexed page content retrieved.

resources.name: Unity 6.6 model-format reference
verifiedFacts: The page identifies FBX as the normal internal model import chain and recommends it for production model files.
Native authoring-file import can depend on installed authoring software.
resources.license: Unity documentation terms; engine licensing is separate.
resources.access: Public documentation. No Unity editor installed by this research.
claimCorrections: A universal recommendation to replace FBX with glTF for Unity is contradicted by this official model workflow.

sources.evidence: Page read; version marked current in documentation navigation.

resources.name: Unity glTFast package
verifiedFacts: The reviewed documentation identifies version 6.14.1.
The package provides glTF import/export in the editor or at runtime and is installed by name through Package Manager.
resources.license: Check the pinned package license and dependencies before redistribution; no asset rights inferred.
resources.access: Public package documentation; package installation was not performed.
claimCorrections: com.unity.cloud.gltfast is a separately installed package, not automatic built-in glTF support in every Unity project.

sources.evidence: Documentation version and feature statement read.
Package-manager name and installation steps read.

resources.name: Unreal FBX content pipeline
verifiedFacts: Epic documents FBX support for meshes, animation, morph targets and LODs.
The page identifies FBX 2020.2 for the import pipeline.
resources.license: Epic documentation terms; Unreal engine and third-party assets have separate terms.
resources.access: Public documentation; no Unreal import performed.
claimCorrections: This does not exclude Unreal's glTF import route or prove every Blender FBX export will preserve all features.

sources.evidence: Official indexed page content retrieved.

resources.name: Unreal Interchange import framework
verifiedFacts: The guide describes glTF support and default-enabled Interchange plugins.
The reviewed page labels its Interchange FBX path experimental.
resources.license: Epic documentation terms; plugin availability is not a third-party asset license.
resources.access: Public documentation; project plugin settings not inspected.
claimCorrections: Unreal is not FBX-only.
The Interchange FBX status must not be generalized to all of Unreal's FBX support.

sources.evidence: Official indexed page content retrieved; rolling documentation version must be matched to the actual engine.

resources.name: Godot stable scene-format reference
verifiedFacts: Godot recommends glTF 2.0 and supports FBX with ufbx.
Direct blend import invokes Blender's glTF exporter and requires Blender to be installed.
resources.license: Documentation reference; Godot and input assets retain their own licenses.
resources.access: Public stable documentation; no new importer installation in this research.
claimCorrections: Old instructions requiring FBX2glTF are not the default current ufbx workflow.
Direct blend support is not independent of the authoring application.

sources.evidence: Page read.

resources.name: Blender render-pass and sampling references
verifiedFacts: Pass documentation describes separate render information and denoising data.
Sampling documentation describes adaptive sampling and denoising controls.
resources.license: Documentation reference; no tutorial or asset content mirrored.
resources.access: Public manuals; examples still require testing in the pinned renderer.
claimCorrections: Enabling more passes or denoising is not an automatic quality or performance improvement.

sources.evidence: Official indexed page content retrieved.

resources.name: Blender color-space and display-transform references
verifiedFacts: The manuals distinguish color spaces from viewing/output transforms and describe intermediate OpenEXR handling.
resources.license: Documentation reference; no OCIO configuration or source assets copied.
resources.access: Public versioned manuals. The second page is the Indonesian-locale manual with the relevant technical text available in English.
claimCorrections: An ACES or AgX label does not prove that a multi-application color round trip was configured correctly.
